description.en: The ID of the API product.
The APIs that you want to detach from the API product.

description.zh:
环境名称，取值为：

- **RELEASE**：线上
- **PRE**：预发
- **TEST**：测试
description.en:
The environment to which the API is published. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**: the production environment

- **PRE**: the pre-release environment

- **TEST**: the test environment

title.zh: 解除API与API产品的绑定关系

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi detach-api-product --api-product-id 117b7a64a8b3f064eaa4a47ac62aac5e --apis StageName=RELEASE ApiId=ba84c55eca46488598da17c0609f3ead --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DetachApiProduct --region cn-hangzhou --Apis.1.ApiId ba84c55eca46488598da17c0609f3ead --ApiProductId 117b7a64a8b3f064eaa4a47ac62aac5e --Apis.1.StageName RELEASE
